title: AI Actors for UGC Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Create UGC ads from one product photo. Choose an AI actor, write the line, and make a fresh cut for paid ads, product pages, or social posts.
h1: Make More UGC Ads with AI Actors
lead: Make a fresh UGC ad from one product photo. Choose an actor, write the line, and test another hook before booking a shoot.

m2.h2: How to Make an AI Actor Video in 3 Simple Steps
m2.lead: Upload a product photo, write your line, and choose an actor who fits the audience.

steps.sourceHint: One clear product photo is enough to start
steps.prompt: This is the moisturizer step I keep beside the sink.

items.d: Start with one clear product photo that shows the item your customer will receive. Keep the full shape and color visible so the actor can present the right product.
Write the exact line you want the actor to say. Choose an actor and setting that fit the product and the audience you want to reach.
Download the vertical ad when the line and delivery look right. Post it as a paid ad, product page video, social post or setup guide.

faq.a: An AI actor is a generated presenter for a product video. You choose the person and give them a line to deliver on camera.

faq.q: How do AI actors turn a script into a video?
faq.a: Write the words, choose a presenter and generate the clip. The actor's voice and lip movement follow the line you provide.

faq.q: What product photo should I upload?
faq.a: Upload one clear photo that shows the full product, its color and the details the actor needs to hold or explain.
Yes. Choose from 53 adult presenters across different ages, styles and settings, then open the spokesperson workspace with that presenter selected.

faq.q: What sizes and lengths are available?
faq.a: The actor tool starts with a 9:16 vertical clip. The workspace offers 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and this directory starts with 10 seconds.

faq.q: How much does an actor video cost?
faq.a: A 10-second actor video costs 40 credits. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Where can I use videos made with AI actors?
faq.a: Use them as paid social ads, on product pages, in organic social posts and in short product guides after you review the final clip.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is generated, so do not frame the video as a real customer review and follow the disclosure rules for the platform where you publish it.
